raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure displays two line plots comparing the training rewards of two models, Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY, across different training sets. The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," shows training rewards on the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, plotted against the number of steps on the x-axis, which ranges from 0 to 500. The Llama-On-Policy-Easy model (blue line) starts at a training reward of approximately 0.0 and increases to around 0.38, showing a steady upward trend with some fluctuations. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy model (red line) starts at a similar point and also increases, reaching a final reward of about 0.4, with a slightly more volatile pattern. The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," has a y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.2 and the same x-axis range. The Llama-On-Policy-Hard model (blue line) begins at 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.02, remaining very low throughout. The Llama-LUFFY-Hard model (red line) starts at 0.0, increases to about 0.18, and then continues to rise to approximately 0.22, showing a consistent upward trend with minor fluctuations. Both plots use solid lines with markers to represent the data points.
